issue: 1. rat unbound fraction rests on one source
searched: PubMed for rat plasma protein binding / unbound fraction of PFAS from any laboratory; the project's own protein_binding.csv for rat albumin
found: PARTLY MOVES. No second rat PLASMA f_u exists. But rat albumin binding is held from six studies, and Starnes 2024 measured rat and human albumin for the same 8 compounds in one assay -- an independent cross-species comparison that the paper did not use.
effect: The direction DISAGREES with Ryu (Kd ratio 0.68 against f_u ratio 1.32, agreeing on 1 of 5 compounds). Starnes cannot adjudicate, because its absolute Kd implies f_u near 0.4 where the measured value is near 0.003. Report as an unresolved cross-method disagreement, not as support.

searched: PubMed for controlled human PFAS kinetic studies beyond Abraham 2024
found: NO MOVE. The project already carries the population alternatives it can (Zhang 2013 n=66, Fujii 2015 n=10, Harada 2005 n=20). No further controlled-dosing human study was located; deliberate human dosing is not repeatable.
effect: none; the existing population sensitivity analysis is the available mitigation

issue: 4. PFOS: tubular secretion or biliary elimination
searched: PubMed for PFOS biliary excretion, enterohepatic circulation and rat bile studies
found: PARTLY MOVES. Harada 2007 measured human biliary clearance directly and states biliary excretion is comparable in rats and humans. The project holds the extract but has never used it.
effect: Bounds the alternative: human PFOS biliary clearance 2.98 gross, about 0.089 net of 97% reabsorption, against a renal clearance of 0.012-0.037 mL/kg/day. The non-renal route is the same size or larger, so a falling TOTAL clearance can plausibly be biliary. Still no rat dose series in bile or urine, so the two are bounded, not separated.

issue: 5. PFBA and PFBS lack a human renal clearance
searched: PubMed for human urinary or renal clearance of PFBA and PFBS
found: NO MOVE. Nothing located. Olsen 2009 observed urine as an elimination pathway in its human subjects but published no clearance, and Chang 2008's human arm reports serum half-lives only.
effect: none; these two remain blocked on the human side, as Stage 18 concluded

searched: PubMed for single-strain mouse PFAS kinetic series across several compounds
found: NO MOVE WITHIN THE PRESENT SET. Fujii 2015 is one strain (FVB/NJcl) across 7 carboxylates and already supplies the mouse dose series; the mixing arises where Chang 2012 (CD-1) and Sundstrom 2012 are brought in for the sulfonates.
effect: could be narrowed by restricting the mouse column to Fujii's strain at the cost of losing the sulfonates; a presentational choice, not new evidence
